_note: Dungeons outside the Blizzard achievements "Dungeonerforscher": those that are in no achievement, and the halves of a criterion for counterparts of both factions. They appear in the tab "Dungeons und Raids" and on the character page, sorted by minimum level into their achievement tier. Fields: name (German, as displayed), tier (achievement tier: Novize, Erfahren or Meister), levels [min, max] and bosses (if missing, those from config/dungeons.json apply), source (completion: victories over the final boss according to the boss kill statistic "Siege über ENDBOSS (INSTANZ)", with finalBoss as ENDBOSS and instance as the name in parentheses), image (retail journal-instance ID or image URL; if missing, config/instance-images.json applies), faction (HORDE or ALLIANCE, optional: only characters of this faction count, because Blizzard mirrors the statistic of counterparts onto the other faction), replaces (optional: achievement criteria this entry replaces; if the criterion is done, it counts as completion for characters of their own faction). "_check" names uncertainties.
